data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: items failing fk_grade <= 8 / banned_words_found empty / active_voice = true appear in rationale.deviations with populated reason field
- dd-6: post-processing overwrites checks{} and (re)adds deviation entries but preserves any pre-existing rationale.deviations[].reason for same rule_id; inserts 'unjustified' placeholder when no author-supplied reason

## Description
Implement plugins/dso/scripts/gov_copy_postprocess/deviations.py with `build_deviations(item, existing_deviations, fk_max) -> list[dict]`. For each failed rule emit deviation with rule_id and reason. Look up existing rule_id; preserve its reason verbatim; otherwise insert reason='unjustified'. Passing items yield no deviations.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh --runner=pytest --test-dir=plugins/dso/tests/scripts/
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-lint.sh
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-format-check.sh
- [ ] RED tests now pass
  Verify: pytest plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_gov_copy_postprocess.py -k build_deviations

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/gov_copy_postprocess/deviations.py: Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
data.title: GREEN impl: deviations.py build_deviations with reason preservation
